question: Should OpenClaw expose a public OpenAPI/Swagger contract, and if so which Gateway HTTP/RPC surfaces are stable enough to include?
rationale: A generated schema would define a public API and security/versioning contract; source inspection shows adjacent schema and client surfaces exist, but no maintainer-approved OpenAPI boundary exists yet.

options.title: Define a narrow public schema contract
options.body: Approve a small stable Gateway API subset, version it, document auth/scope behavior, and implement OpenAPI generation only for that subset.

options.title: Use SDK publication instead
options.body: Treat generated clients as a future SDK/package deliverable and leave OpenAPI out of core until the SDK is public.

options.title: Decline for now
options.body: Close the request as not planned if maintainers do not want OpenClaw to publish a stable generated API contract yet.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow public schema contract
recommendation.body: Approve a small stable Gateway API subset, version it, document auth/scope behavior, and implement OpenAPI generation only for that subset.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent docs and SDK/Gateway integration work makes this the best available owner signal for the API-boundary decision.
